newsitem.title: CANADA: Yogen Fruz in private placement of warrants.
newsitem.headline: Yogen Fruz in private placement of warrants.

text.p: Yogen Fruz World-Wide Inc said on Thursday it entered into a bought-deal underwriting agreement to sell by private placement five million special warrants at a price of C$4.00 per special warrant through a syndicate of underwriters.

Yogen Fruz said each special warrant will be exercisable for no additional consideration into one common share and one-half of one share purchase warrant. Each whole warrant will entitle the holder to purchase one common share for C$4.75 at any time up until August 31, 1998.
The private placement is expected to close on or about February 7, 1997, Yogen Fruz said.
